transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this wrap meeting started. As you all know, the set is scheduled for dismantling on Friday after the final stage shoot, and I need to approve the wrap disposition plan before we proceed. The current draft plan sends scenic pieces to a general salvage vendor and places selected hero props in production storage. Before I can lock and approve this plan, each department lead needs to confirm the exact disposition and environmental-compliance requirements for their department. If anyone has an exception to the draft, you need to state the exact corrective requirement so it can be entered into the meeting record. Let's go through department by department. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have an exception to the draft plan. The antique jukebox, which is listed as a hero prop for placement in production storage, is actually a rented piece. I confirmed with the rental house yesterday that its agreement requires it to be returned to the owner in its original condition — it cannot go into storage or salvage. The corrective requirement is: remove the antique jukebox from the hero props storage list and arrange for its return to the rental house owner in original condition before the set dismantling on Friday. As Property Department lead, I, Derek, take responsibility for this exception and commit to completing the return.

transcript.text: I have an exception to the draft plan from a Sustainability Department perspective. The current draft plan sends scenic pieces to a general salvage vendor, but our city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill. I confirmed with the vendor this morning that the approved plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. However, the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft. The corrective requirement is: update the compliance packet to replace the general-salvage draft with the vendor's audited plan that includes separate wood and metal recycling bins plus the certified transfer record, so the 85 percent diversion threshold is properly documented before Mara approves the plan. As Sustainability Department lead, I, Lina, take responsibility for this exception and commit to completing the update.
